title: Auditing a single-structure virtual screen of the HPV16 E6 zinc-finger pocket: a negative verdict, control-calibrated reporting, and the lineage confound in E6 sequence analysis
description:
Code, data and results archive for an audited negative docking-to-MD virtual screen of 14 ChEMBL candidates against the HPV16 E6 E6AP-interface pocket (PDB 4GIZ-derived receptor, bonded ZAFF/CYM zinc model, DMSO and E6AP LxxLL controls, 3 x 20 ns replicas per complex, MM-PBSA re-scoring, exploratory GaMD check), plus a lineage-confound analysis of 878 HPV E6 sequence records (45 types, type-level statistics, type-grouped cross-validation, selection-free dual-zinc conservation scan).

The archive includes the full analysis pipeline (50+ numbered scripts), every results table and figure, the receptor/zinc structural templates with a machine-readable reconstructed ZAFF parameter file, the ChEMBL library and candidate provenance tables, the Vina pose sets for both receptors (4GIZ used, 4XR8 excluded and documented), and per-run GaMD analysis outputs. Raw trajectories were lost with the compute instance and are documented as such; everything needed to rebuild the systems and re-run is archived.
